kind: estimated API-equivalent cost, not billed charges or Codex subscription allocation
scope: Original Task A turn and reviewer, through both final responses. This follow-up, integration, commits and publication are excluded.
mode: Standard-rate scenario requested by user; actual service tier not logged
rate_source: User-supplied pricing screenshot, preserved as pricing-reference.png. Base prices also checked against official OpenAI pricing on 2026-10-20.
long_context_rule: User-supplied rule: input/cache rates double for requests exceeding 272000 input tokens. No original-task request crossed that threshold.
formula: ((input - cached_input - cache_write_input) * 2.00 + cached_input * 0.10 + cache_write_input * 2.50 + output * 10.00) / 1000000; cache_write_input = 0.
pricing_uncertainties: Actual Codex billing, subscription fees, credits and service tier are unavailable. This is a hypothetical API-equivalent estimate at the supplied standard rates.
double_counting_note: Cached tokens are charged at cached rates instead of uncached rates. Reasoning output is already inside output and is not charged twice.
